orgUsagePolicy.description: Org-usage layer knobs (contract §2.3/§6.6). maxOrgUsageAgeDays: owner decision D-2 2026-08-03 = 90, PROVISIONAL until the sandbox refresh cadence is recorded — the value must stay <= that cadence, and compute_org_lane applies min(stored expiresAt, observedAt + current policy) so tightening the policy expires existing blocks retroactively. allowedOriginRemotes: gate-1 containment allowlist (owner decision D-1 2026-08-03, refined: single-repo model — the whole workspace lives in the company's private GitHub Enterprise repo, org observations are committed there, and the public origin is never a remote of it nor ever allowlisted) — empty means entry-org-attach refuses everywhere, and a failing git remote enumeration is a refusal, never a pass.
